translations.web: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
translations.bsb: Surely there is no righteous man on earth who does good and never sins.
translations.kjv: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth
translations.asv: Surely there is not a righteous man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
